instruction.name: xvilvl.d
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, interleave the 64-bit elements in the lower half of that lane from `a` and `b`: the element from `b` is placed at the even output position and the element from `a` at the following odd position.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvilvl.d $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvilvl.d $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvilvl.d $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvilvl.d $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvilvl.d $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvilvl.d $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvilvl.d $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvilvl.d $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
